# GSAP skills index for this workspace

gsap-core
  Core tweens, transforms, easing, defaults, autoAlpha, and matchMedia.
  Triggers: gsap.to, gsap.from, gsap.fromTo, easing, transform aliases, autoAlpha, responsive animation, reduced motion.

gsap-timeline
  Sequencing, labels, nested timelines, and playback control.
  Triggers: timeline, sequencing, choreographed animation, position parameter, labels, playback.

gsap-scrolltrigger
  Scroll-linked animation, pinning, scrub, refresh, horizontal scrollytelling.
  Triggers: ScrollTrigger, pin, scrub, scroll animation, horizontal scroll, scrollytelling, refresh.

gsap-react
  React and Next.js integration, useGSAP, refs, scope, context, cleanup.
  Triggers: React animation, Next.js animation, useGSAP, gsap.context, cleanup on unmount, scoped selectors.

gsap-performance
  Smooth 60fps animation, transforms over layout props, batching, and avoiding jank.
  Triggers: performance, jank, 60fps, smooth motion, layout thrashing, will-change.

gsap-utils
  Helper utilities such as clamp, mapRange, normalize, interpolate, random, snap, selector, wrap, pipe.
  Triggers: gsap.utils, clamp, mapRange, normalize, random, snap, selector, wrap, pipe.
